correctness.rationale: The unique greedy embedding gives a bijection between descendants and canonical deletion pairs, yielding the identity with rainbow triples. Given the binary adjacent-change pattern, each consecutive-change rainbow flag has independent success probability (q-2)/(q-1). Block enumeration gives both generating-polynomial forms. A centered Bernoulli expansion establishes the exact variance. Direct exhaustive enumeration reproduces 27 parameter cases and a separate greedy counter cross-check passes. The proof explicitly handles n=2 and q=2, so finite tests are not used as an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: This is a complete and natural finite-block distribution, not an arbitrary slice. The polynomial supplies exact tails and arbitrary moments for every integer alphabet size and length, exposes an essential nonbinary triple-distinct correction, and provides precise deletion-channel degree heterogeneity that extremal counts and binary variance do not determine. Its interest does not depend on a speculative downstream theorem.
